links.description: Overall visual character: warm off-white/cream backgrounds, black/near-black text and dark panels, a single orange accent used selectively for emphasis and primary CTAs, and a premium abstract glass/geometric hero illustration rather than gaming/anime/cyberpunk imagery - consistent with a 'modern, confident, structured, premium without being luxury-only, gaming-aware without looking like an esports clan page' brand direction.

RVS Esports tournament registration appears on the homepage as a concrete example of one Nanashi business vertical (gaming/esports), consistent with the umbrella-brand positioning shown in the 'One Name, Many Possibilities' band rather than the band's explicit five categories (which do not list esports directly).

links.label: depicts a night-sky astrophotography scene: a dense starfield on near-black background with the Milky Way's bright, cloudy galactic core/band sweeping diagonally through the center from lower-middle to upper-right, dusted with warm beige and cool blue-green star clusters and dark dust-lane striations; a faint reddish star and a thin diagonal streak (possible meteor or satellite trail) appear in the upper-left quadrant; overall mood is deep, moody, atmospheric and cosmic — likely used as a dark full-bleed hero/section background image for a TCG 'trade' feature page, evoking themes of collecting, rarity, and vastness

links.description: The five-vertical band (Digital/Commerce/Media/Aero/Technology) visually reinforces the hero's 'independent venture and technology house' framing, signaling Nanashi as a multi-business umbrella brand rather than a single-niche (gaming/TCG/drone) brand.

Screenshot shows a full-width dark band reading 'ONE NAME. MANY POSSIBILITIES.' with five icon+label verticals: Digital (Products & Solutions), Commerce (Stores & Marketplaces), Media (Content & Production), Aero (Drone & Aerial Media), Technology (Hardware & Systems), plus the N logomark at the far right.

Screenshot shows a hero with large uppercase-spaced 'NANASHI' headline, tagline 'GIVING FORM TO POSSIBILITIES.' (POSSIBILITIES in brand orange), an IDEA -> STRUCTURE -> OUTCOME process strip, supporting body copy describing Nanashi as an independent venture/technology house, two CTAs ('Explore Nanashi' filled orange, 'Our Services' outlined), and a dark abstract 3D glass/geometric hero visual with light streak lines on the right.

Screenshot's bottom-visible section shows an 'RVS ESPORTS' eyebrow label, 'LIVE TOURNAMENT REGISTRATION' heading, and the start of two dark tournament/game promo cards (one with a winged 'A' emblem resembling an Apex Legends-style mark, one with armored character art).
